I wouldn't pay for than $5 for this. It is a very medicore FPS game.  Sure the Warhammer universe is nice, but take that away and you have a very linerar, uninsipred shooter.

I didn't complete the game.  It has one of those cardinal sins.  Right before the big boss fight, you have this unskippable monolog the bad guys gives.  So each time you have to re-try the final fight, you have to sti through the whole thing all over again.

In any case,  what I presume to be the final fight, is uninsipred, with just a bunch of waves of enemies you fought before.  Pretty much thats all it has been for the past few levels anyway, only in the end, you get them all at once.  It is also only an 8 hour game.  I do not undersand why FPS publishers think super short games are reasonable.  Virtually every other genra of game gives you far more hours per dollar spent.

My love for Relic and the Warhammer 40k franchise is no secret, but Space Marine is truly one of my favourite third-person games of all time and one of two games that I miss now that I'm OS X only (the other being DoWII: Retribution). The action is fast and furious in this one, and there are few games which offer an equally satisfying and visceral experience. The campaign is admittedly linear and the multiplayer is janky at the best of times, but the game's actual play is exhiliarting.

Surprisingly entertaining game. The story is rather predictable but fits very nicely into the Warhammer 40k universe. Characters are stereotypical as hell, but that's what W40k is like. Combat is pretty intense, extremely bloody and really almost comically exaggerated in its violence, again fitting perfectly into the Warhammer 40k aesthetic. Guns feel pretty great sound effects are majorly really convincing. The interacton between ranged and melee combat is very good since both are rather well balanced and both are fun. 
Want some pretty mindless action with 6-7 hours of quasi non-stop banging action set in a dark gothic far future universe with Space Marines in huge and clunky armor and as green as stupid SPACE ORKS(!!!)? This is your game.
